correctness.rationale: For d,n>=2 and integer r>=1, Wick expansion of four Gaussian TT replicas has exactly three pairings per physical position. A mismatch forces pairing 0; the bond transfer T has diagonal 1, off-diagonal 1/r, eigenvalues c=1+2/r and a=1-1/r. Thus K(I,J)=c^(d-1)∏(1+2(a/c)^gap)/3 and K(I,I)=3c^(d-1). All weights positive prove the nonnegative covariance; F is strictly decreasing and log-convex for r>1, establishing consecutive maxima and balanced endpoint-spanning minima. Expanding diagonal quadratic forms proves the exact variance and the 2-spike case. A fresh independent Wick enumeration agrees on all 36 cases across (d,r)=(2,2),(3,2),(3,3),(4,2), including variance 52 versus 99/2. Degenerate r=1,k=1,d boundary cases follow directly; finite tests are corroboration, not infinite proof.
residual_risks: All conclusions require independent real Gaussian cores and constant finite rank; the arbitrary-sign diagonal variance expression does not entail a universal arrangement optimum for general diagonal data.

evidence: Bujanović–Kressner–Olić treat normalized TT coordinate fourth moment and trace-estimator moment/concentration bounds; TTStack and tensorized projection results provide estimates rather than the exact two-index spacing product.
